mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_prompt_template (template_key, template_name, category, content, variables, description, is_active, config_version, updated_by) VALUES (#{templateKey}, #{templateName}, #{category}, #{content}, #{variables}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{configVersion}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ai_prompt_template WHERE template_key = #{templateKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_ai_prompt_template WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY category, id
SELECT * FROM t_ai_prompt_template WHERE is_active = 1 AND category = #{category} ORDER BY id
